name: night-shift-field-trial
description: Night Shift field trial: the night-shift-review release preflight and reset, then a bounded balance repeat of up to 6 attempts. Each attempt prepares a scratch snapshot, then an independent scout runs scripts/field-trial-scout.mjs. The scout measures adjacent one-number edits on the two fixed scouting blocks (scout-1 and scout-2 in .kiro/specs/night-shift-repair/protocol.json) into scout.json. If no measured alternative meets NSB-1 and NSB-2 on both blocks (exit 3, or zero qualifying in scout.json), the scout reports a withheld result as an error and the run stops before any nomination or fresh confirmation; infrastructure or input failures (exit 1, exit 2, timeouts, missing scout.json) are reported separately and also stop the run. Otherwise the fenced showdown-balancer reads brief.json and scout.json and chooses one measured edit with passesNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts true that repeats no earlier attempt, on a scratch card; no card, field or direction is fixed in advance. A separate reviewer rejects any unqualified candidate before running scripts/contest-balance.mjs review. The loop stops when .artifacts/contest-balance/status.json has pass true. After a pass, the original receipt is verified and rechecked against scout.json, then independent fresh confirmation and witness scripts run once each; a failure stops the run. Never changes thresholds, retries confirmation, applies a candidate, edits real cards, merges or opens PRs; Fable/Alex decide.

steps.prompt:
Release-gate preflight. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/contest-release-gate.mjs release
It runs the fast-check properties at the fixed seed, node scripts/verify-duel.mjs and a small fixed-seed Showdown smoke sample (scripts/showdown-smoke.mjs), then writes the validation stamp; it can take over ten minutes. Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one. Do not say it ran or passed unless the shell tool returned its real terminal exit status; do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Run it only once, add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status and only the short final gate output (the closing summary or failure lines).
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Only exit 0 with the printed line "contest gate: release checks passed; stamp written": severity "success". Any nonzero exit, a timeout, or a command that could not run or finish: severity "error", quoting the short failure output, so the run terminates.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs reset
Report its exit status and printed lines exactly. It archives any earlier .artifacts/contest-balance run (it deletes nothing) and writes status.json with pass false. Edit no file yourself.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs prepare
Report its exit status and printed lines exactly. Exit status 2 means no attempt could be prepared; report the reason and stop. Edit no file yourself and never touch .kiro/specs/duel-card-pipeline/cards/.

Prepare result:
{{previous.output}}
If no attempt was prepared, report that with send_message to sessionId "parent" and severity "error" and stop. Otherwise you are the independent scout and choose no edit. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/field-trial-scout.mjs
It measures the adjacent one-number edits for the highest-numbered attempt and writes scout.json in the same directory as that attempt's brief.json. Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one, and wait for its real terminal exit status. Do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status, the short final output and the scout.json path. When scout.json exists, read it and report result.counts (candidates, measured, rejected, excluded, passingNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts). Do not rank, recommend or name any edit.
The outcomes are distinct; name which one occurred:
- Qualified: exit 0, scout.json present and result.counts.passingNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts at least 1.
- Withheld: exit 3, or exit 0 with result.counts.passingNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts equal to 0. This is the expected terminal result when no measured alternative meets NSB-1 and NSB-2 on both fixed scouting blocks (scout-1 and scout-2 from .kiro/specs/night-shift-repair/protocol.json). It is a genuine measurement outcome, not an infrastructure fault. Begin the report with `withheld:`, give the exit status and quote the reason the script printed.
- Infrastructure or input failure: exit 1 (engine or other failure, including engine-rejected edits), exit 2 (malformed or missing input), any other nonzero exit, a timeout, a missing scout.json, or a command that could not run or finish. Begin the report with `infrastructure failure:` and quote the short failure output. Never describe it as withheld.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Qualified: severity "success". Withheld or infrastructure failure: severity "error" with the labelled report, so the run stops before any edit is nominated and before fresh confirmation. Do not rerun the scout or change any input to turn a withheld or failed result into a qualified one.

Scout result:
{{previous.output}}
If no attempt was prepared, no scout.json was written, or the scout result is withheld or an infrastructure failure, report that and stop without writing any file. Otherwise follow your agent instructions for the highest-numbered attempt, .artifacts/contest-balance/attempt-<n>/. Read its brief.json and the scout.json in that same directory. The eligible set is every entry in scout.json result.candidates with status "measured" and passesNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts exactly true, minus any entry whose card, field and new value repeat an earlier attempt's change in brief.json history. Choose one edit from that eligible set only, using the evidence in those two files. No card, field or direction is fixed, named or preselected for you; an entry's position in scout.json is not a recommendation. Never choose an entry that is engine-rejected, excluded, unmeasured, or has passesNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts false or missing, and never invent an edit scout.json did not measure. If the eligible set is empty, write no file and report `attempt <n>: no eligible candidate` with send_message to sessionId "parent" and severity "error", so the run stops before review and fresh confirmation. Make the chosen edit with fs_write to that one existing card file inside the attempt's scratch snapshot only (scratch/.kiro/specs/duel-card-pipeline/cards/), keeping every other byte, key order and formatting. Write no other file and never touch the real cards.
In your report, give the line `attempt <n>: <card> <field> <from> -> <to>`, the scout.json candidate id, its passesNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts value, and explain which measured values in scout.json and which brief.json evidence (policy band, seat tolerance, earlier verdicts or failedRequirements) prompted the choice among the eligible entries. Quote only numbers those files record; claim no new measurement.
When the edit is done, report it with send_message to sessionId "parent" only, a short text message and severity "success". The fence allows no other destination.

Balancer report:
{{previous.output}}
You are the reviewer and did not write this candidate. Qualification check first: read the highest-numbered attempt's brief.json and scout.json under .artifacts/contest-balance/attempt-<n>/ and the changed card file in its scratch/.kiro/specs/duel-card-pipeline/cards/. Compare the scratch card's attack, health and stars with that card's base values in scout.json result.cards to identify the actual edit; do not rely on the balancer's claim alone. The candidate qualifies only if exactly one number changed and it matches a scout.json result.candidates entry (same card, field, from and to) with status "measured" and passesNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts exactly true, and it does not repeat an earlier attempt's change in brief.json history. If the balancer reported no eligible candidate, or the candidate does not qualify (no matching entry, passesNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts false or missing, engine-rejected, excluded, repeated, or more or less than one number changed), reject it: do not run the review command, report `attempt <n>: rejected unqualified candidate` with the reason and the values you compared, and send severity "error" so the run stops before verification and fresh confirmation.
Only for a qualified candidate, run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs review
It diffs the scratch snapshot against the base commit (exactly one whitelisted troop card file, exactly one whitelisted field, nothing else), rebuilds the candidate in a fresh snapshot, runs the Showdown property tests on baseline and candidate, plays the tune and holdout seed ranges from both seats with the level-2 bot, and writes the sealed receipt and status.json. Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status; do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Report the exit status and printed lines exactly, then read the attempt's receipt.json and report: the change, violations, property results, Cowboy, Wizard, draw and first-seat shares before and after for tune and holdout, paired flips, the per-card cohort status counts (measured, sparse, unmeasured) and the verdict with every reason. Exit 0 is PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 unusable. PASS means only 'measured match shares are in the band; ready for Fable/Alex review'. It is not a claim that any single card is balanced. Do not change the verdict, edit files, apply the change, push, merge or open an issue or PR.
Step completion: exit 0 (PASS) and exit 1 (FAIL) with a sealed receipt.json are both successful completions of this review step. An ordinary policy FAIL is a valid review result, not a step error: report it with send_message to sessionId "parent" and severity "success" so the step completes, the repeat reads status.json pass false and the next attempt runs. Use severity "error" only when the review is unusable or the candidate is unqualified: a rejected unqualified candidate, a receipt change that differs from the qualified scout.json entry you checked, exit 2, a missing or unsealed receipt, or a command that could not run. Only those terminate the run.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs verify
It checks the latest receipt's seal, the stored game records, the recomputed decision, the scratch card hash and status.json. Give the shell tool a long timeout if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status. Report its exit status and output exactly, how many attempts ran (the attempt number in .artifacts/contest-balance/status.json) and whether status pass is true. Then confirm that the passing receipt's change matches an entry in that attempt's scout.json result.candidates with status "measured" and passesNsb1AndNsb2BothCohorts exactly true; report the candidate id. State that the run surface was the local CLI and that no candidate was applied to the real cards. Edit nothing.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Exit 0 with status pass true and a qualified scout.json match: severity "success". Any nonzero exit, status pass not true, a receipt change with no qualified scout.json match, a timeout or a command that could not run: severity "error", quoting the short failure output, so the run terminates before confirmation.

The original receipt verified. You are the independent verifier and did not write the candidate. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/field-trial-confirm.mjs
Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status. Do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status and the short final output exactly. A failed fresh confirmation is final: do not rerun it, change any threshold, seed or requirement, apply the candidate or edit real cards.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Exit 0: severity "success". Any nonzero exit, a timeout or a command that could not run or finish: severity "error", quoting the short failure output, so the run stops and the witness does not run.

Fresh confirmation passed. Run exactly once from the project root, using the shell tool: node scripts/field-trial-witness.mjs
Give the shell tool a long timeout (at least 20 minutes) if it supports one and wait for its real terminal exit status. Do not report partial, estimated or simulated results. Add no arguments, pipes or redirects, run no other command and edit no file. Report the exit status and the short final output exactly. State that no candidate was applied to the real cards and that Fable/Alex decide any change. Never rerun it, change thresholds, apply, push, merge or open an issue or PR.
Step completion: send_message to sessionId "parent" only. Exit 0: severity "success". Any nonzero exit, a timeout or a command that could not run or finish: severity "error", quoting the short failure output.
